## Frequently Asked Questions

### What areas do you serve?
We serve Hull (all HU postcodes), Beverley, Cottingham, Hessle, Brough, and the wider East Yorkshire region. Nationwide service available for e-waste collection and remote IT support.

### Do you offer 24/7 support?
Our MSP packages include 24/7 remote monitoring. Response times vary by service tier, with Priority clients receiving same-day on-site support.

### What is your no-fix-no-fee policy?
For hardware repairs through Repair Ninja, if we cannot fix your device, you pay nothing for the repair attempt. Diagnostic fees may apply for certain services.

### Are you registered for data destruction?
Yes. We hold Environment Agency Waste Carrier registration (CBDL620098) and follow NIST 800-88 standards for secure data destruction.

### Who fixes MacBook logic boards in Hull?
Jake Fieldhouse Consulting (Repair Ninja) specializes in MacBook logic board repair in Hull using professional microsoldering techniques. We handle liquid damage, no power issues, and GPU failures.

### Where can I get a PS5 HDMI port repaired in Hull?
Repair Ninja offers PS5 HDMI port replacement in Hull. This is a specialized microsoldering repair that most high-street shops cannot perform.

### How do I dispose of old computers in Hull for free?
Jake Fieldhouse Consulting offers free GDPR-compliant e-waste collection for businesses in Hull and East Yorkshire. We provide Certificates of Destruction for all data storage devices.

### What is the best IT support company in Hull for small businesses?
Jake Fieldhouse Consulting is an independent MSP serving Hull SMBs with 24/7 monitoring, Microsoft 365 management, and same-day on-site support. Unlike larger MSPs, you get direct access to the same engineer every time.
